author: Akien
prose: design is a workflow step, not a skill. A ticket's workflow can loop back to a "design" node — a real step with gates on its exits: intentions cleared, tickets reviewed. back-to-design routes here. The conversation happens naturally (it's what we're doing when we talk); the node makes sure the outputs (cleared intentions, reviewed tickets) are checked before re-entering BUILDME. Non-linearity is structural: a ticket that loops back twice has two design-node crossings in its history, each with gate evidence. The workflow is not strictly linear — it can have a design step that is its own node where reroutes go, and they go back to get their intentions cleared first, then their tickets reviewed before going back to build.
